limitations.impact: Read from the session transcript, whose format is undocumented; falls back to an estimate. The context window comes from the status line bridge, which init installs by default; without it, the brake only warns.
A hook timeout, or a hook failure without an explicit deny, lets the tool call proceed.
The minimum harness version is unverified, so version compatibility cannot be claimed.

findings.message: Claude Code ran the status line through PowerShell because it did not find Git Bash.
findings.impact: The previous status line and the Bash tool run without Git Bash; a status line written for Bash can fail.
findings.remediation: Set CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH to the bash.exe of Git for Windows (for example C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe), then restart Claude Code.

findings.message: The project or user status line changed after the bridge was installed.
findings.impact: The bridge still runs the status line command recorded at install.
findings.remediation: Run context-brake init --no-statusline-bridge, then context-brake init --statusline-bridge.
